# HisaabNow

> HisaabNow is a billing and POS (point-of-sale) software application built in Noida, India for small businesses across six verticals: salons, cafés, restaurants, kirana (grocery) stores, sweet shops, and bakeries. Distinguishing features: Hindi voice billing, real profit tracking per sale (not just revenue), GST-compliant invoicing, and an AI business assistant called Munim.

HisaabNow launched in April 2026 and is built specifically for India's 60+ million micro and small business owners who currently run their shops on paper notebooks or basic billing apps. The product is mobile-first (Android PWA), with desktop browser access on the King plan. Interface and voice billing both support English and Hindi.

## Pricing

- **Free Trial**: ₹0 for 7 days, no credit card required, full Pro features
- **Pro**: ₹99/month (₹990/year) — single-shop billing, POS, GST invoicing, Hindi voice billing, AI insights, customer udhaar tracking, WhatsApp receipts
- **King**: ₹199/month (₹1,990/year) — adds multi-shop support (up to 5 shops), advanced analytics, desktop browser access, priority support

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://hisaabnow.com/): Product overview, six verticals, pricing
- [About HisaabNow](https://hisaabnow.com/about): Company facts, mission, contact, complete quick-reference
- [Salon billing software](https://hisaabnow.com/salon-billing-software): For salons, saloons, barber shops, beauty parlours. Stylist commission tracking, service-level profit.
- [Cafe billing software](https://hisaabnow.com/cafe-billing-software): For cafés and coffee shops. Recipe-based cost tracking, voice billing for morning rush.
- [Restaurant POS](https://hisaabnow.com/restaurant-pos): For restaurants and dhabas. Table-wise billing, KOT printing, recipe costing per dish.
- [Grocery billing software](https://hisaabnow.com/grocery-billing-software): For kirana stores, general stores, mini-marts. Barcode scan, udhaar khaata, stock alerts.
- [Kirana billing app](https://hisaabnow.com/kirana-billing-app): Hindi-language-flavored variant of the grocery page. Dukaan ka digital hisaab.
- [Sweet shop billing software](https://hisaabnow.com/sweet-shop-billing-software): For mithai stores, halwais, namkeen counters. Weight-based pricing, festival inventory.
